result.summary: Found two visual issues involving a navigation state mismatch and inconsistent layout spacing.

issues.description: The active navigation state highlights 'Profile' while the app clearly displays the 'Home' screen content.
issues.suggestion: Synchronize the bottom navigation active indicator with the currently displayed view.

issues.description: Vertical spacing between section headers and restaurant cards varies across the home feed.
issues.suggestion: Implement a standardized vertical margin system for all major UI sections.
